notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page has only the name, county and forest, with no history. The state list gives coordinates and county; OpenStreetMap tags an observation tower at about 7 m, which matches the brief's elevation. Two searches found no build date, height, staffing or condition. A May 2025 Black Swamp Fire on the Croatan National Forest (about 950 acres) came up in search; nothing links it to this tower, so it is not used. Status and access are unknown; the Croatan National Forest should confirm before anyone visits.
